class.name: Box3DDirectSpaceState3D
class.description: [Box3DDirectSpaceState3D] is returned by [World3D.direct_space_state] when the Box3D physics server is active. It supports the stock [PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D] query API plus Box3D-specific material query helpers.

method.name: intersect_ray_ex
method.description: Runs the same ray query as [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D.intersect_ray], and returns the stock hit keys plus [code]material_id[/code], [code]material_name[/code], and [code]material[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary on a miss.
